entities.name: Q5UPZ0 DNA ligase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to the analyzed 636-residue protein.
Reviewed annotation identifies an NAD-dependent DNA ligase, EC 6.5.1.2.
Catalyzes phosphodiester-bond formation between 5′-phosphoryl and 3′-hydroxyl termini in double-stranded DNA using NAD+ as coenzyme and energy source.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass about 72.1 kDa; theoretical pI 9.03; predicted net charge at pH 7 about +11.
Pfam domains: DNA_ligase_aden (PF01653) at residues 91–290 and BRCT (PF00533) at residues 561–627.

entities.name: NAD-dependent DNA ligation
observations: NAD+ + DNA nick substrates → sealed DNA + AMP + beta-nicotinamide D-nucleotide, as reported for EC 6.5.1.2.

entities.name: DNA repair and replication
observations: Curated Gene Ontology annotations associate the protein with DNA repair and DNA replication.
